title: Deployment Console — Infrastructure Parameters Contract
description: The agent's config contract. A valid 'parameters' object that passes this schema is injected into the CDK app via `cdk deploy -c parameters='<this object>'`. Structural validation only; cross-field rules (conditionals, arithmetic) live in validate.py. Mirrors infrastructure/config/parameters.json.

availability_zone.description: Single-AZ placement. 'id' is the AZ ID (e.g. use1-az4), required when app_with_s3express is true.

name.description: AZ name, e.g. us-east-1a. Must be an AZ in the deployment region.

id.description: AZ ID, e.g. use1-az4. Required iff app_with_s3express=true (see validate.py rule 1).

app_with_codepipeline.description: Toggle: deploy the CodePipeline/CodeBuild CI/CD stack. Requires GitHub identity fields (validate.py rule 8).

app_with_fsx.description: Toggle: deploy the FSx for Lustre stack (fast scratch, auto-mounted at /fsx).

app_with_s3express.description: Toggle: deploy an S3 Express One Zone directory bucket. Requires availability_zone.id (validate.py rule 1).

deployment_type.description: Which compute stacks to deploy. Gates which sub-block is required (validate.py rule 4).

per_unit_storage_throughput.description: MB/s per TiB. AWS minimum 50. Only APPLIED for PERSISTENT_2 (no-op otherwise, validate.py rule 3).

storage_capacity_gib.description: Filesystem size in GiB. AWS minimum 1200 (mirrors FSxStack._validate_inputs).

object_expiration_in_days.description: Lifecycle expiry for the standard bucket.

custom_arns.description: Extra S3 bucket ARNs the Batch job role may read/write. DANGEROUS: grants access to arbitrary buckets — should be an explicit allow-list, never agent-freeform (see security notes in CONFIG_SCHEMA_PLAN.md).

instanceClass.description: AWS EC2 instance CLASS (family without size), uppercased as CDK ec2.InstanceClass expects, e.g. C6I, R5, R7I, G5, P4D. Not an exhaustive enum — CDK accepts a large set; pattern guards shape only.

containerCommand.description: Container entrypoint command. LOCKED FIELD — agent must NOT set this; if editable it is arbitrary code execution. Enforced in validate.py / tool layer, not structurally.

singleNode.description: CPU compute env config. Required when batch.deployment_type is SINGLE_NODE or ALL.

maxv_cpus.description: Max vCPUs across the compute env. Soft-capped by account quota.

minv_cpus.description: Min vCPUs kept warm. Must be <= maxv_cpus (validate.py rule 5).

num_queues.description: Number of parallel queues/compute-envs. maxv_cpus is divided across them (floor).

container_cpu.description: vCPUs per job. Must be <= floor(maxv_cpus/num_queues) (validate.py rule 5).

container_memory.description: MiB per job. Must fit chosen instance classes (validate.py rule 9, advisory).

multiNode.description: GPU multi-node config. Required when batch.deployment_type is MULTI_NODE or ALL.

maxv_cpus.description: Max vCPUs. Must cover main + workers (validate.py rule 6).

instance_classes.description: Must include a GPU-capable family (G/P) if any container_gpu>0 (validate.py rule 6).

gpuNode.description: A node group in the multi-node job (main = node 0, worker = nodes 1..N). Node indices are advanced/topology fields (validate.py rule 7).
